sources.title: Juice Generation Columbus Circle reviews | Exa place listing
sources.text: The service at this location is bad. I usually order ahead on the app with no issue to save time but the last 2 times I’ve been including today, I had to wait an extra 10 minutes to be handed my order. Today the short guy with square glasses at the register was laughing and talking with a friend (which is fine) and I was the only other customer inside so I figured it wouldn’t take too long because I could see my order sitting there ready. When their conversation ended the guy at the register proceeded to ignore me, move a couple things around and then disappeared into the back. Slow service for online orders. I ordered on the app which predicted the smoothie would be ready in 15 minutes. I arrive a couple minutes early and stood there and watched as people who walked in ordered and got their drink within minutes, yet I had yet to get mine. When I asked about my drink after the time I was supposed pick it up at 12:06, i see the staff grabbing the receipt to go make it. There must have been 6 walk-ins that got their drinks before I did.

description.value: Juice Generation Columbus Circle sits at Columbus Circle 979 Eighth Avenue btw 57th & 58th, open 7:00 AM 9:00 PM. The chain's menu runs from Smoothies Fresh Juices Hotties Bowls to bottled juices. A Restaurantji reviewer praises the Great selection of flavors, nice you can make your own mix and also creatine and protein options to add in, wheatgrass cocktails, immunity shots, salads and fruit bowls. Another notes that the juices are labeled and put in the refrigerator for pick up as soon as they are made, which helps on a grab-and-go morning before Central Park.
